div.div: 1 وَسَجَ , (aor. يَسِجُ, K,) inf. n. وَسِيجٌ (S, K) and وَسْجٌ and وَسَجَانٌ; (L;) He (a camel) went a certain pace; (S, L, K;) [more quick than that called عَسْجٌ: the contr. is said in the TA, app. by a mistranscription: but see نَصَبَ, and ذَمَلَ:] the first pace, accord. to En-Nadr and As, is called الدَّبِيبُ; the next, العَنَقُ; the next, التَّزَيُّدُ; the next, الذَّمِيلُ; the next, العَسْجُ; and the next, الوَسْجُ: or he went quickly, or swiftly. (TA, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
